result.description:
Steamatic is Australia’s longest established and largest restoration Company with over 35 locations throughout Australia and growing each year. We have available work Nationwide in Metropolitan and Regional areas.

We are now looking to recruit an experienced and qualified IT Support Technician to join our dedicated service team working in various locations throughout Australia.

The Role
We are looking for technically skilled candidate with good problem-solving ability for the position of IT Support Technician. The duties include being a reference point for all IT related queries at the user level, responding to user needs in a timely manner and ensuring the optimal running of all systems, among other technical duties.

The role includes but is not limited to the following duties:
Installing and configuring hardware and software components to ensure usability
Diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving connectivity, hardware, and software issues
Performing tests and evaluations of new software and hardware
Scheduling and conducting quality audit inspections, and analysing and reviewing systems, data and documentation
Identifying variations and potential high-risk areas in securing adherence to standards and procedures
Recommending corrective action plans and improvements in the resolution of non- compliance with standards detected through monitoring and auditing of processes and procedures
Communicating, educating, and liaising with users and management to ensure awareness and adherence to standards, procedures and quality control issues and activities
Assisting in troubleshooting, diagnosing, testing and resolving system problems and issues
Developing, conducting, and offering technical guidance and training in application software and operational procedures
Analysing, evaluating, and diagnosing technical problems and issues such as installation, maintenance, repair, upgrade and configuration and troubleshooting of desktops, software, hardware, printers, Internet, email, databases, operating systems and security systems
Testing, identifying and diagnosing functionality errors and faults in systems, and programming code within established testing protocols, guidelines and quality standards to ensure systems perform to specification
Performing organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, and recommending current and future hardware and software strategies and directions
Creating and reviewing technical documentation such as procedural, instructional and operational guides and manuals, technical reports and specifications and maintenance inventory systems
Using project management methodologies, principles, and techniques to develop project plans and to cost, resource and manage projects
Test plans, which ensure acceptable quality and integrity of the system
Creating user and training documentation, and conducting formal training classes
Establishing good relationships with all departments and colleagues
Working with users to formulate and document business requirement
Investigating, and analysing business processes, procedures and work practices

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Previous work experience in the same field
3+ years of experience in computer networks and systems maintenance
Proficiency in computer systems, software installation, database programming, and cybersecurity basics
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Good interpersonal skills
Strong problem-solving, and time management skills
Attention to detail
Self-motivated and eager to learn and grow within the organisation

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

result.description: REDEEM SKILLS RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS   REDEEM SKILLS RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS (RECRUITER) on behalf of   Rushlee Pty Ltd  ,   Geelong VIC 3220   Join Rushlee as a Systems Administrator, where you will be responsible for maintaining and supporting the organisation's IT infrastructure, networks, servers, and business systems to ensure secure, reliable, and efficient operations. The role involves monitoring system performance, troubleshooting technical issues, managing user access, implementing cybersecurity measures, and supporting technology upgrades. This position is integral to maintaining business continuity, enhancing operational efficiency, and providing a stable technology environment that supports Rushlee's workforce and ongoing business growth.   Benefits   Competitive remuneration   Full-time, stable employment with a growing, locally owned business  Supportive team environment with a focus on safety and professionalism    Task & responsibilities   Install, configure, administer, and maintain the organisation's servers, operating systems, business applications, cloud platforms, and network infrastructure to ensure reliable and secure operations.  Monitor the performance, availability, and security of IT systems and networks, proactively identifying and resolving issues to minimise downtime.  Manage user accounts, access permissions, email services, and authentication controls in accordance with organisational security policies.  Provide technical support to employees by diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, network, and system-related issues in a timely manner.  Implement, maintain, and monitor cybersecurity measures, including firewalls, endpoint protection, system updates, backups, and disaster recovery processes to safeguard organisational data.  Perform routine system maintenance, software upgrades, security patching, and configuration management to optimise system performance and reliability.  Administer and maintain databases, data storage solutions, and backup systems to ensure data integrity, availability, and secure information management.  Develop and maintain IT documentation, system configurations, operational procedures, and asset registers to support effective system administration.  Liaise with external technology vendors and service providers to coordinate system maintenance, software licensing, technical support, and infrastructure upgrades.  Support and maintain business technology including workstations, mobile devices, telecommunications systems, printers, and remote access solutions.  Assist management in planning, implementing, and improving IT infrastructure and technology solutions that enhance operational efficiency and support business growth.  Ensure all IT systems and practices comply with organisational policies, privacy obligations, cybersecurity standards, and other applicable regulatory requirements.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Administration, Systems Administration, or a related field.  Minimum 1 year of full-time relevant work experience (or equivalent part-time/casual experience) in systems administration, IT support, or network administration.  Demonstrated experience administering Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, cloud platforms, and business IT systems.  Sound knowledge of networking technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, routers, switches, and wireless networks.  Experience managing system security, backups, disaster recovery, and software updates.  Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills across hardware, software, and network environments.  Excellent organisational, communication, and time management skills.  Ability to work independently and collaboratively while providing technical support to end users.  Knowledge of information security, data privacy, and compliance requirements, with healthcare or community services experience being advantageous.   About Company     Rushlee Pty Ltd is a Geelong-based information technology company specialising in network infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud networking, IT support, and system administration services. The company provides reliable and secure technology solutions to businesses across various industries. With a strong focus on innovation, network performance, and customer service, Rushlee Pty Ltd supports the design, maintenance, monitoring, and enhancement of business-critical IT systems and network environments. Highway Supplies Pty Ltd t/a Ravensthorpe Roadhouse

Retail Supervisor (ANZSCO 621511 – Retail Supervisor)

Full-time/Permanent

$80,000 - $82,000 (salary will be commensurate to qualifications and experience)

Duties and Responsibilities:

*Supervise and coordinate the day-to-day activities of retail sales and customer service staff
*Prepare staff rosters, allocate duties and ensure adequate staffing levels during each shift
*Train, coach and provide ongoing guidance to retail employees
*Monitor staff performance and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures
*Ensure customers receive prompt, courteous and professional service
*Respond to customer enquiries, complaints and service issues in a timely manner
*Supervise point-of-sale transactions, cash handling, EFTPOS payments and daily till reconciliations
*Ensure products are correctly priced, labelled, displayed and replenished
*Monitor stock levels and coordinate the ordering and receipt of merchandise
*Check incoming deliveries against purchase orders and report damaged or incorrect stock
*Monitor stock rotation, expiry dates, wastage and inventory discrepancies
*Assist with regular stocktakes and implement measures to minimise stock losses
*Ensure promotional displays and merchandising activities are implemented correctly
*Maintain the cleanliness, presentation and security of the retail and customer service areas
*Ensure staff comply with workplace health and safety, food safety, hygiene and fuel-site safety procedures
*Complete opening and closing procedures and ensure company property, keys and security systems are properly controlled
*Assist the Retail Manager with achieving sales, customer service and operational performance targets
*Perform other supervisory duties associated with the operation of the roadhouse, as required

Qualifications and Experience:

*Relevant AQF Certificate III or higher qualification
*3 years of relevant experience may substitute for formal qualifications
*Applicants with qualifications will need to demonstrate a minimum of 1 year of relevant experience

Retail Manager (ANZSCO 142111 – Retail Manager (General))

Full-time/Permanent

$82,000 - $85,000 (salary will be commensurate to qualifications and experience)

Duties and Responsibilities:

*Organise and control the overall retail operations of Ravensthorpe Roadhouse
*Determine the appropriate product range, stock levels and service standards to meet customer demand
*Develop and implement purchasing, pricing, sales and marketing policies
*Monitor sales performance, market trends and customer preferences and take corrective action where required
*Prepare and analyse sales forecasts, operating budgets and expenditure reports
*Monitor business costs, profitability and financial performance against established targets
*Manage supplier relationships and negotiate prices, purchasing arrangements and delivery schedules
*Order merchandise and ensure sufficient stock is available to meet operational requirements
*Monitor inventory levels, stock rotation, wastage, shrinkage and damaged or expired products
*Plan and coordinate stocktakes and investigate inventory discrepancies
*Recruit, train, supervise, motivate and performance-manage retail and customer service staff
*Prepare staff rosters and ensure appropriate staffing levels are maintained
*Establish and monitor customer service standards
*Respond to customer enquiries, complaints and significant service issues
*Plan and coordinate promotional activities, merchandising displays and seasonal campaigns
*Ensure point-of-sale, cash-handling and banking procedures are properly followed
*Maintain accurate records of sales, purchases, stock movements, expenses and other financial transactions
*Ensure the roadhouse is maintained in a clean, safe, secure and presentable condition
*Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety, food safety, fuel-site safety, employment and consumer requirements
*Implement operational procedures to improve efficiency, customer satisfaction and profitability
*Perform other managerial duties associated with the operation of the roadhouse, as required

Qualifications and Experience:

*Relevant AQF Diploma
*3 years of relevant experience may substitute for formal qualifications
*Applicants with qualifications will need to demonstrate a minimum of 1 year of relevant experience

result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Database Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the design, implementation, and ongoing management of our database systems. The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the integrity, security, and performance of organisational data assets. This role suits a proactive and technically proficient professional with a strong background in database management and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality data infrastructure. Experience working within a collaborative IT environment and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders will be highly regarded.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain database architecture, data structures, tables, and naming conventions to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of all data master files
- Establish, monitor, and maintain backup and recovery procedures, ensuring business continuity and minimal disruption in the event of a system failure
- Implement and enforce database security protocols, integrity controls, and access management policies to safeguard sensitive organisational data
- Administer and maintain comprehensive database documentation, including guidelines, policies, and operational procedures, ensuring these remain current and fit for purpose
- Plan and perform database upgrades, patches, and migrations, including thorough testing, debugging, and issue resolution in accordance with approved quality assurance processes
- Monitor database performance on an ongoing basis, identifying bottlenecks and implementing tuning, indexing, and optimisation strategies to maximise efficiency
- Collaborate with developers, systems analysts, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into effective and scalable database solutions
- Analyse existing database systems and workflows, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance reliability, performance, and maintainability
- Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance for database-related incidents, working to resolve issues promptly and minimise operational impact
- Ensure database environments comply with relevant data governance frameworks, privacy legislation, and organisational standards, including alignment with Australian Privacy Principles where applicable
- Assist in capacity planning activities by assessing current usage trends and forecasting future storage and performance requirements
- Support the development and maintenance of data integration processes, including ETL pipelines and data warehouse environments, in collaboration with cross-functional teams
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a Database Administrator or similar role, with hands-on responsibility for managing enterprise-level database environments
- Proficiency in one or more leading relational database management systems, such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
- Strong working knowledge of SQL, including query writing, stored procedures, functions, and performance tuning
- Experience designing and implementing backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies in production environments
- Solid understanding of database security principles, including user access controls, encryption, and audit logging
- Ability to diagnose and resolve complex database performance issues through monitoring tools, execution plans, and indexing strategies
- Familiarity with data modelling techniques and the ability to translate business requirements into well-structured database designs
- Sound understanding of IT service management practices and experience working within structured change management processes
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to troubleshooting
- Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with both technical teams and business stakeholders
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant vendor certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional, or equivalent
- Experience with cloud-based database platforms, including Azure SQL, Amazon RDS, or Google Cloud SQL
- Exposure to NoSQL database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or Redis
- Experience in data warehousing environments and familiarity with ETL tools and processes
- Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automation of routine database tasks
- Familiarity with DevOps practices and experience working within Agile or ITIL-aligned environments
- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as finance, healthcare, or government, with an understanding of associated compliance obligations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive and collaborative team culture that values continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development
- Access ongoing training opportunities, certification support, and clear pathways for career progression within a growing technology function
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options, to support a healthy work-life balance
- Work on meaningful, complex data challenges that have a genuine impact across the organisation
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with additional benefits including superannuation, annual leave loading, and access to an employee wellbeing programme
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Location: Balmoral, QLD, 4171
Full-Time: Immediate start
Reports to: Centre Manager & ECT
Job Title: Child Care Worker
Salary range: $79,500 - $86,600 - depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closure date: 30 days

About This Role:
We are seeking a passionate and nurturing Child Care Worker for an exclusive partnership with a prestigious, community-focused preschool. This role is ideal for an educator who believes in the power of a holistic, play-based approach and values creating a warm, homelike environment for children. The centre prides itself on its beautiful, natural settings and its philosophy that emphasises emotional security, creativity, and foundational learning through exploration. We are looking for a dedicated professional who can contribute to this nurturing atmosphere, design a stimulating program inspired by the Early Years Learning Framework, and build strong, collaborative relationships with families and the wider community. This is a unique opportunity to join a team deeply committed to providing an exceptional early learning experience.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Program Delivery & Child Development:
• Design and implement stimulating educational programs aligned with the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF)
• Facilitate intentional teaching moments through play-based activities including storytelling, music, art and sensory exploration
• Observe and document children's progress to support individual learning goals and share insights with families
• Guide social-emotional development by modelling positive behaviour and conflict resolution strategies

Daily Care & Wellbeing:
• Maintain impeccable hygiene standards including nappy changing, toileting assistance and mealtime supervision
• Create predictable routines that provide children with emotional security while allowing flexibility for spontaneous learning
• Conduct thorough safety checks of indoor/outdoor environments and resources before activities
• Administer first aid when required and follow health management plans for children with additional needs

Family & Community Engagement:
• Build trusting relationships with families through daily conversations and formal progress updates
• Collaborate with room leaders to create displays that make children's learning visible to parents
• Participate in community events and centre initiatives that strengthen family connections

Compliance & Professionalism:
• Maintain current working with children check - first aid certification and relevant qualifications
• Contribute to quality improvement processes through reflective practice
• Attend staff meetings and professional development sessions to enhance practice

Skills & Requirements:
• Certificate III or Diploma in Early Childhood Education & Care (or ACECQA-approved equivalent)
• Proven 1-year minimum experience in long day care or similar setting.
• Demonstrated knowledge of EYLF and National Quality Standards
• Genuine passion for early childhood development with endless patience and creativity
• Current First Aid, Asthma & Anaphylaxis certificates as well as proof of vaccination
• Working with children rights
• Police check
• Strong communication skills to engage with children, colleagues and families
• References from previous employers

Why Apply?
This is more than a job - it's an opportunity to shape young lives in an environment that values educator wellbeing as much as child development. You'll receive:

• Above-award wages for qualified candidates
• Paid professional development opportunities
• Supportive leadership team with realistic expectations
• Purpose-built facilities with quality resources

If you're ready to make your mark in early childhood education with an organisation that values your expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply:
Submit your resume and cover letter addressing your experience with the EYLF and your approach to play-based learning. Successful applicants will require valid working rights and must pass background checks.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.
